title: Ontario Grade 10 Principles of Mathematics (MPM2D) — Success Criteria

overalls.title: Properties of Quadratic Relations
overalls.description: determine the basic properties of quadratic relations

specifics.description: I can identify the key features of a parabola including the vertex, axis of symmetry, zeros, and intercepts.
I can explain the roles of a, h, and k in y = a(x - h)² + k and sketch graphs by applying transformations to y = x².

overalls.title: Solving Quadratic Equations
overalls.description: solve quadratic equations and interpret the solutions with respect to the corresponding relations

specifics.description: I can expand, simplify, and factor polynomial expressions including trinomials and differences of squares.
I can solve quadratic equations using factoring, completing the square, and the quadratic formula.
I can model real-world situations with quadratic functions and solve optimization and word problems.

overalls.title: Line Segments and Circles
overalls.description: model and solve problems involving the intersection of two lines, and verify geometric properties of triangles and quadrilaterals

specifics.description: I can calculate length, midpoint, and slope of line segments and write the equation of a circle.
I can verify properties of geometric figures (such as medians, perpendicular bisectors, and quadrilaterals) using analytic geometry.

overalls.title: Linear Systems
overalls.description: solve problems involving the intersection of two lines

specifics.description: I can solve linear systems algebraically using substitution and elimination and apply them to application problems.

overalls.title: Right Triangle Trigonometry
overalls.description: use the primary trigonometric ratios and the Pythagorean theorem to solve problems involving right triangles

specifics.description: I can use primary trigonometric ratios and the Pythagorean theorem to solve 2D and 3D right-triangle problems.

overalls.title: Acute Triangle Trigonometry
overalls.description: solve problems involving acute triangles, using the sine law and the cosine law

specifics.description: I can use the Sine Law and Cosine Law to solve for unknown sides and angles in acute triangles.
